_comment: Kingmaker's Kronos vertical: the connector for Conway-Research/automaton, run behind Kingmaker's rails (lib/automaton.mjs). Both the agent and the gate-off toggle ship OFF. The owner, 2026-10-15: 'youre just giving kingmaker a cnnector for it so i dont have to do so manually' and 'Include the gate-off toggle too: ships off, needs a second confirmation and a spend cap, then automaton acts autonomously.' Pins are the integrity anchor: a git commit hash checksums the whole tree. Keys/wallet are never here; they are sealed in the Mac's Keychain.

program.name: Automaton (Conway Research)
program.summary: Conway's open-source autonomous agent, run only behind Kingmaker's rails.
program.install: Clone at the pinned commit, REA-scan as a repo connector, run under lib/automaton.mjs. See installPlan().

skills.summary: Conway's skills. No licence on the repo, so never bundled or republished: fetched from Conway on this Mac only when enabled, at the pinned commit.

gate.onMeans: every money action and every self-modification asks first (consent to the owner's phone)

offToggle.thenMeans: money actions within the cap run autonomously; self-modification still asks; replication is still refused

rails.realFunds: live mode only; dry-run (default) and testnet never move real money
rails.killSwitch: 'stop approving' (said or typed) stops the agent and its children, freezes spending, and puts the gate back on; only the owner clears it at the console
rails.wallet: keys sealed in this Mac's login Keychain (service 'Ronin Automaton Wallet'), never on disk
rails.audit: every decision logged (shown in Kingmaker and the Ronin dashboard); problems go to the phone
